title: console AI chat: the seed warning after publishing drafts shows the seed loader's engine text, or "[object Object]"
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbUb7TcZK1XUAddUmQ

Filing gate: out-of-scope finding from the `os-dev` of #35141 (PR #35301), class a, filed by seat 5. ⛔ Not a claim. Same family as #35141 and #32984 (user-facing text must be a pack sentence), a second producer outside that card's fence. Lease `ux-1`.

## What happens

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (around :3212 on main), `onPublishDrafts`: the `console.ai.seedWarn` toast uses `seedApplied.error` (the seed loader's engine text) as its description. When there is no `error`, it uses `String(seedApplied.errors[0])`, which renders `[object Object]` for a structured `{ row, reason }` error row.

## Expected

The description is a translated pack sentence, the same shape #35141 gives the publish-all toast. Engine text and row objects go to the console log or a details affordance, not to the toast.

## Done when

Both arms show a pack sentence in en and zh; a test pins the structured-row arm (no `[object Object]`) and the engine-text arm.

Dedupe words: console.ai.seedWarn, AiChatPage seedApplied.error, seed toast object Object.
